captions.detailed: A dual-stage wide-format window box fan featuring a light-grey rectangular plastic housing with rounded corners. The front of the unit has a dark-grey grille panel with vertical ventilation slots, which pivots open from a horizontal hinge at its top edge. A central cylindrical speed control knob is mounted on the front face above the grille, while two independent internal fan blades are visible through the slots, designed to rotate continuously.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a wide-format window box fan with a rectangular housing. It must include two internal blade-and-motor stages that can rotate continuously, a front grille panel with vertical slots that pivots open via a top horizontal revolute joint, and a central speed knob that rotates continuously.
captions.factory: Construct the main housing by creating a box and filleting its edges. Create the front grille panel as a separate thin box with vertical slot cutouts, and attach it to the housing using a revolute joint along the top edge. Model the control knob on the front face using concentric cylinders, and define a continuous rotation joint on its central axis. Inside the housing, model two identical fan assemblies, each consisting of a central motor cylinder and helical blade sweeps, and mount them using continuous joints to simulate independent rotation.
